# Organic Shape Animations — Codium fasciculatus

Original: https://github.com/codrops/OrganicShapeAnimations
Demo: https://tympanus.net/Development/OrganicShapeAnimations/
Copyright 2017 Codrops. main.js declares the MIT license.

Repository resource terms: this resource can be used freely when integrated into or
built upon for personal or commercial projects. It may not be sold, redistributed
or republished as-is, or sold as a pluginized version. Free plugins built using it
must visibly mention and link the original work. Included assets have separate licenses.

This prototype adapts the first specimen's SVG contours and 800 ms cubic/quartic
motion to click-driven matrix transitions using the existing GSAP runtime.
Original image assets and colored decorative backgrounds are not included.
reference.html and reference.js are local implementation references, not loaded by the app.
codium-paths.js contains the two original contours. codium-flow.js implements the adaptation.
